title: DDIA 11 · STREAM PROCESSING
subtitle: Batch with the input never ending. Events are processed shortly after they happen.

blocks.text: "Image resize jobs go on SQS, since they are independent with per-message retry.
Another group reads the same data independently with its own offsets. Adding consumers doesn't cost the producer anything.
And if the app crashes between the two writes, one system has the change and the other doesn't. Writing to two systems is never atomic.
Every derived system (search, cache, warehouse) consumes the log and updates itself. Each can be rebuilt by replaying from offset 0, or from a snapshot plus the log.
State is a derived view, a fold over the events. You can build new views later by replaying, and debug by replaying to any point in time.
Session: group a user's activity until a gap, as in web analytics and Strava activities.

CDC (Debezium) or outbox → Kafka → idempotent consumers. Never dual-write.
Ordering, replay, or many consumers → Kafka. Independent tasks with per-message retry and DLQ → SQS.
